A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TimeLens research and contain readable text, tables, figures, equations, and appendices. Content can be matched across relocation and renumbering without material comparison gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, annotation-error statistics, training experiments, and ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results and adds evaluated baselines and VUE-TR results in Table 10.

M1.justification: The timestamp encoding, thinking-free RLVR objective, difficulty-aware sampling, early stopping, and data-curation procedures are retained. The Qwen3-specific preliminary SFT stage was already documented in v1 Appendix B.2.

E1.justification: v2 Appendix D adds evaluation on the external, human-annotated VUE-TR temporal-grounding benchmark. Existing training sources, TimeLens-Bench, original benchmark evaluations, and Video-MME coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 substantially broadens the evaluated open-source comparison set by adding TRACE, TRACE-uni, TimeSuite, Grounded-VideoLLM, and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B. These introduce additional grounding approaches and a much larger general-purpose comparator; all previous comparators remain.

E3.justification: The added VUE-TR evaluation is explicitly labeled 0-200s and reports IoU in Table 10. Previously reported splits, training settings, resolution budgets, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. The new explanation that Table 2 uses RLVR-trained models clarifies an existing experiment.

E4.justification: The timestamp, training-paradigm, training-data, and model-size ablations, training curves, and thinking-process observations are retained. VUE-TR supplies additional benchmark scores, while the new appendix discussion adds interpretations without new ablations or robustness tests.

E5.justification: Neither version reports evaluation seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The training reward standard-deviation curve in Figure 6 is retained unchanged.

E6.justification: Existing numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. v2 adds scores for the five Table 1 comparators and a VUE-TR comparison: TimeLens-7B reports 45.1 IoU, versus Gemini-2.5-Pro's 41.6, Qwen2.5-VL-7B's 36.0, and GPT-4o's 34.5. These are additional results, not improvements to previously reported scores.

T1.justification: The task formulation and Equations 1-9, covering the RL objective, rewards, difficulty definition, and density-corrected Gaussian sampling, are unchanged. No new theorem, proof, or derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and relocated conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about data quality, TimeLens-Bench/100K, training recipes, and competitive grounding performance. Additional experiments support these retained claims without redefining the main contribution.

C2.justification: New Appendix F explains VideoChat-R1 and Time-R1's differing benchmark behavior and the interaction between timestamp encoding and post-training. It also qualifies early stopping as a practical single-task recommendation that may require different treatment in multitask training. Appendix D interprets VUE-TR results as evidence of external generalization.

D1.justification: Appendix F explicitly documents that all timestamp-encoding methods in Table 2 are compared after RLVR training. This improves documentation of the existing comparison; implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, prompts, and release statements otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds LLaVA-ST and Grounded-VideoLLM citations to the related-work coverage and discusses differences from VideoChat-R1 and Time-R1 in Appendix F. The central positioning as a systematic investigation and baseline remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The conclusion moves from main-text Section 6 to Appendix A. v2 adds acknowledgements, an external-evaluation paragraph, and Appendix F, with corresponding section renumbering and limited wording edits. Most existing prose is retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains five comparator rows, and a new VUE-TR Table 10 is inserted. The previous Video-MME Table 10 becomes Table 11. Existing figures and table designs are retained, with local relocation and page reflow.

improvement.justification: The broader Table 1 comparisons and external VUE-TR evaluation strengthen support for the existing recipe beyond the authors' refined benchmarks. Appendix F also improves interpretation by qualifying the early-stopping recommendation and clarifying the timestamp comparison. The gain is limited: original results remain unchanged, and the new VUE-TR evaluation receives only brief protocol documentation.
